name: Splunk
summary: Send Ogun run and approval events and metrics to Splunk through the HTTP Event Collector, on Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud Platform.

fields.name: hec_token
fields.label: HEC token
fields.help: Sent as Authorization: Splunk TOKEN. Read from the exporter process environment, not Ogun's secret store.

settings.name: host
settings.label: HEC host
settings.help: Host only. Splunk Cloud Platform shows its HEC host in the deployment's settings.

settings.name: port
settings.label: Port
settings.help: 8088 is the HEC default; your deployment may use another.

settings.name: index
settings.label: Index
settings.help: Leave empty to use the token's default index.

notes: Metrics: ogun.workflows, ogun.runs.active, ogun.approvals.pending, ogun.streams, ogun.node_instances by state. Events: failed runs and approvals waiting for a person.

implementation.evidence: Sink in ogun-export, written from public documentation and checked against a local fake in unit tests; not run against the real service.
